title: OGS Joseki Loss by Opening
dataSources: Steam activity and achievements (`steam:activity`), Chess.com games (`chesscom:game`), online-go matches (`ogs:game`), and poker home-game hands or settlements (`pokerhome:session`).
app: Gaming and play telemetry from Steam, Chess.com, Online-Go servers, and poker home-game logs sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and export files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ogs:game
| search opening_name=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as games avg(loss_flag) as loss_rate by _time opening_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks OGS opening losses over time and breaks it out by opening.
value: Opening-level loss rate helps you decide whether one joseki choice is creating recurring trouble.
implementation: Send OGS opening losses events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of OGS opening losses by opening.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how OGS opening losses changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
